mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, region, reason, evidence_urls, status, reject_reason, audit_by, submitted_by, submitted_at, audited_at, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_verification WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM merchant_verification WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_verification( merchant_id, region, reason, evidence_urls, status, reject_reason, audit_by, submitted_by, submitted_at, audited_at, effective_start_at, effective_end_at ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{region}, #{reason}, #{evidenceUrls}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{auditBy}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt}, #{auditedAt}, #{effectiveStartAt}, #{effectiveEndAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_verification SET reason = #{reason}, evidence_urls = #{evidenceUrls}, status = 1, reject_reason = '', audit_by = 0, submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, audited_at = NULL, effective_start_at = NULL, effective_end_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND region = #{region}
mapper.select: SELECT mv.id, mv.merchant_id, mv.region, mv.reason, mv.evidence_urls, mv.status, mv.reject_reason, mv.audit_by, mv.submitted_by, mv.submitted_at, mv.audited_at, mv.effective_start_at, mv.effective_end_at, mv.created_at, mv.updated_at, m.company_name AS company_name FROM merchant_verification mv JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mv.merchant_id WHERE mv.id = #{verificationId} AND mv.region = #{region} AND mv.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_verification SET status = 2, reject_reason = '', audit_by = #{auditBy}, audited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, effective_start_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, effective_end_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE merchant_verification SET status = 3, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
